contact.title: Write to the team
contact.lead: A person from the team answers by e-mail, usually the same working day. Bought a ticket? Write to the organizer of your event: their contact is in the ticket e-mail.
contact.name: Your name
contact.privacy: We keep your message to answer it. Questions and answers, without your name and e-mail, help us improve the answers on this site. [Privacy policy](/legal/privacy)
contact.sent: Thank you. Your message reached the team; the answer comes to {email}.
contact.error.invalid: Fill in your name, a valid e-mail and the question (at least 10 characters).
contact.error.turnstile: The anti-spam check did not pass. Wait a second for it to finish and try again.
contact.error.rate: Too many messages. Try again in a few minutes.
contact.error.unavailable: The form is not available right now. Write to us in the Telegram chat or at {email}.
contact.error.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
subscribe.popup.title: Ticket sales tips by e-mail
subscribe.value: Practical tips on selling tickets, one short e-mail every two weeks.
subscribe.consent: By subscribing you agree to receive these e-mails. Unsubscribe at any time. [Privacy policy](/legal/privacy)
subscribe.sent: Check your inbox and confirm your address: we sent a message to {email}.
subscribe.error.turnstile: The anti-spam check did not pass. Wait a second for it to finish and try again.
subscribe.error.rate: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
subscribe.error.unavailable: Subscribing is not available right now. Try again later or write to {email}.
subscribe.error.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
subscribe.confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
subscribe.confirm.ok: Thank you, your address is confirmed. The tips will arrive by e-mail, one short message every two weeks.
subscribe.confirm.expired: This link has expired. Subscribe again with the form at the bottom of any page and we send a new one.
subscribe.confirm.invalid: This link does not work. It may have been used already. Subscribe again with the form at the bottom of any page.
subscribe.confirm.network: We could not reach the server. Open the link again in a few minutes.
subscribe.unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
subscribe.unsubscribe.text: Press the button and we stop sending you these e-mails.
subscribe.unsubscribe.done: Done. You are unsubscribed and will not get these e-mails any more.
subscribe.unsubscribe.invalid: This link does not work. Use the unsubscribe link from the latest e-mail or write to the team.
consent.title: Analytics on this site
consent.text: We count visits to learn which pages help organizers and which do not. The data stays with ArenaSoldOut.com and is not shared with anyone. You can change your choice at any time with “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page.
consent.necessary.name: Necessary
consent.necessary.text: Always on. Remembers your choice and your theme, and keeps the application form safe.
consent.analytics.name: Analytics
consent.analytics.text: Off until you accept. The pages you open, time on a page, how far you scroll, clicks on marked buttons and where your visit came from, linked by a random code in a cookie for 13 months.
